# PermaCold Logistics

PermaCold Logistics is a Warehousing and Storage company. Permacold Logistics is a company that provides cold storage and transportation services. They offer services such as layering and case picking, blast freezing, transportation services, import and export services, inventory services, and value-added services. PermaCold Logistics employs 6 people (+500.0% YoY, +5 people). Headquartered in Darien, Georgia, United States.

## About

At PermaCold Logistics, our mission is to keep your business running smoothly with flexible, reliable cold storage solutions tailored to your needs. We combine hands-on experience with a personal touch to ensure your products remain secure and accessible. 

In a world where cold storage often comes with cold treatment, PermaCold Logistics dares to be different. Here, we call clients friends. We see challenges as opportunities. We meet needs quickly, offer flexibility, and ensure product safety and smooth operations. We transform our industry by staying true to ourselves and true to our partners. That’s what makes PermaCold your true blue.

# PermaCold Engineering, Inc.

PermaCold Engineering, Inc. is a Industrial Machinery Manufacturing company. PermaCold Engineering is an industrial refrigeration engineering leader in "green" system design, construction and service/maintenance, specializing in natural refrigerants, high-efficiency and energy savings, long-term ROI, reduced maintenance, increased safety and performance. PermaCold Engineering, Inc. employs 100 people (-3.8% YoY, -4 people) and has an annual revenue of $13.5M, founded in 1993. Headquartered in Portland, Oregon, United States, with offices in Meridian, Lynnwood, and Pasco.

## About

We believe "refrigeration is an engineered product," and every system is uniquely designed to meet local conditions, your process specifications, and facility requirements. PermaCold is dedicated to engineering and constructing the most environmentally friendly, energy efficient and sustainable systems in the industry.
